result:
Perfect! All tests now pass. 

**The bug:** Line 54 had the condition `s.start < last.end`, which only merges spans that overlap. It should be `s.start <= last.end` to also merge spans that are touching.

**Why it matters:** In half-open range notation `[start, end)`, spans `[1, 4)` and `[4, 6)` are adjacent (one ends where the other starts), so they should merge into `[1, 6)`. The `<` operator was too strict and rejected this case.
